definition: Default-startup JavaScript and the highlights city pack are tracked separately from the reviewed trail experience and optional complete city inventory. The MapLibre 6.19.0 baseline includes both the renderer and its separate worker. The previous embedded-worker build measured 216980 gzip bytes.
measurement: npm run build followed by npm run check:bundle; gzip is zlib level-default. The reviewed-trail chunk and complete inventory are intentionally absent from default startup and measured separately.
